capabilities: Open Booklet-format notes in a dedicated interactive view
Render eight question kinds, widgets and each-pick questions and write answers into the note's records
Keep drafts and dated entries for repeating and daily activities
Draw queries, tables, cards, tiles and SVG charts over kept entries and JSON data blocks
Gate remote audio and video playback behind a per-host allow list
disambiguation: Not an e-book reader or format converter; it renders one specific custom note format (Booklet) as an interactive view inside Obsidian.
extras: Very detailed README covering testing (59-check e2e suite, accessibility measurements), privacy (no telemetry, media hosts see only playback requests), known limits (Android untested, no captions, no PDF export from the view), and compatibility notes with the Linter, Dataview, Tasks, Admonition and Meta Bind plugins. Requires Obsidian 1.11.7 or later.
problem: Obsidian notes are static Markdown with no built-in way to render interactive questionnaires, keep dated answer entries, or draw queries and charts over those answers.
